title: mimi-mls: apply DR-15b check to existing leaves
description: Gaps left by .4.44: Member::create does not check the creator's own leaf against the required safe_aad/app_components lists, and join_welcome / Observer::from_group_info do not check leaves already in the tree. Decide (decision) whether to check and what to do on failure (refuse to join vs warn), then implement with mls-rs-built negative cases.
notes: Decided: mimid-1wgh.4.57 (check own at create; report others at join/observe).
